boards.title: Your First Weekend at Smith College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A daylight-to-evening first-weekend route using public campus destinations, a cultural stop, and a current performance option.

cards.title: Start with the campus map
cards.subtitle: Plan your route before setting out
cards.notes: Use the interactive map to search buildings and view accessibility and parking overlays before choosing the next stop.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for orienting yourself on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith describes its interactive map as an accessible wayfinding guide with building details and parking and accessibility overlays.
cards.access_notes: Use the map’s accessibility overlay to plan an appropriate route.

cards.title: Take a pond-side orientation walk
cards.subtitle: College Lane and Paradise Pond
cards.notes: Walk beside Paradise Pond to get your bearings; the college identifies it as a campus attraction and science learning site.
cards.short_summary: A scenic campus landmark near the main entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith says Paradise Pond, formed by a Mill River dam in the 18th century, is a campus attraction and living laboratory for science students.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor destination; check conditions and follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Step into Lyman Plant House
cards.subtitle: Botanic Garden of Smith College, 16 College Lane
cards.notes: Visit the conservatory’s plant collections and exhibits, then pick up an accessible-route map at the front desk if needed.
cards.short_summary: An indoor garden stop with year-round public access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Botanic Garden says Lyman Plant House & Conservatory is free and open to the public, normally daily from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
cards.source_title: Visit | Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.access_notes: Normally open daily 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed during winter break and hours change for the annual flower show.

cards.title: Continue through the Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Botanic Garden of Smith College grounds
cards.notes: Make this the outdoor counterpart to the conservatory: follow the garden paths and pause at plants or exhibits that catch your eye.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced walk through Smith’s outdoor botanical collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith’s Botanic Garden says its campus arboretum and gardens are open daily to the public year-round.
cards.source_title: Visit | Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor gardens are open daily year-round; groups of 10 or more should schedule in advance.

cards.title: Browse the museum galleries
cards.subtitle: 20 Elm Street at Bedford Terrace
cards.notes: Choose one gallery or exhibition to explore rather than trying to cover everything, and check the museum page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A free art stop in the Brown Fine Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SCMA lists free admission and public museum hours Tuesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
cards.source_title: Visit | Smith College Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Tuesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Mondays and major holidays.

cards.title: Settle into Neilson Library
cards.subtitle: Smith College Libraries
cards.notes: Use the floor-by-floor guide to find a suitable reading or browsing area, and check the live occupancy display before claiming a seat.
cards.short_summary: A library stop for browsing, reading, or a quiet reset.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries provides a floor-by-floor guide, real-time occupancy information, and current hours for Neilson Library.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s current-hours table and entry guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Meet up at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: 100 Elm Street, beside Chapin Lawn
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center as a low-key meetup point, then step outside to Chapin Lawn for a change of scene.
cards.short_summary: A central campus gathering place with access to Chapin Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith says the Campus Center opens onto Chapin Lawn and is open to Smith community members and guests seeking a place to relax.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Engagement | Smith College
cards.access_notes: Guests are included in Smith’s stated Campus Center access; follow facility policies and any posted event restrictions.

cards.title: Pause on Chapin Lawn
cards.subtitle: Outside the Smith College Campus Center
cards.notes: Take a daylight break on the lawn directly outside the Campus Center, then use the map to choose an evening venue nearby.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor pause built into the center of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith’s Office of Student Engagement states that the Campus Center opens out onto Chapin Lawn.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Engagement | Smith College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access may be affected by weather or scheduled campus use.

cards.entity_name: Smith College Music Event at Sage Hall
cards.title: Check the music calendar
cards.subtitle: Sage Hall: Sweeney Concert Hall or Earle Recital Hall
cards.notes: If a music event fits your weekend, confirm its time and venue on SmithArts; Smith lists music events as free and unticketed.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket option for adding a campus performance to the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: SmithArts states that all Music Department events are free and open to the public, with no tickets or reservations required.
cards.source_title: Attend an Event | Smith College Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Confirm the specific event on the performance calendar; the cited page lists Sage Hall music venues.

cards.title: End with a Theatre 14 performance
cards.subtitle: Mendenhall Center for the Performing Arts, 122 Green Street
cards.notes: For a theatre or dance evening, check the current season and buy a ticket only if a listed performance fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A named SmithArts venue for scheduled theatre and dance performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith identifies Theatre 14 in Mendenhall Center as a 460-seat proscenium venue and directs visitors to purchase theatre and dance tickets through SmithArts.
cards.source_title: Attend an Event | Smith College Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Theatre and dance performances use SmithArts ticketing; confirm the current calendar, ticket availability, and accessibility needs before attending.
